<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A horizontal strip of dishes that scrolls sideways (a focusable, named region with snap points): small cards
  with a picture, name, weight, price and an add button. Axes: size (sm, lg), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type DishStripProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  size?: "sm" | "lg";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  size = "sm",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<DishStripProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="star" :title="empty" />
    <List v-else
      tag="ul"
      class="-mx-4 flex snap-x gap-4 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-4"
      :tabindex="0"
      :aria-label="labels.strip"
      data-slot="items"
    >
      <ListItem v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id"
        :class="
          (size as string) === 'lg' ? 'flex w-64 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col gap-2'
          : 'flex w-48 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col gap-2'
        "
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="d.name" :ratio="(((size as string) === 'lg') ? '4/3' : '1/1')" />
        <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ d.name }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ d.weight }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
          <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
            {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
          </Inline>
          <AddIcon :label="tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)" />
        </Group>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
